modules.name: Document, Spreadsheet & PDF Tools
modules.description: High-speed converters and editors for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, JSON, and PDF documents.

modules.name: Image Tools & Extended Converters
modules.description: Multi-format image converter and advanced editing utilities including AI background removal, resizing, filters, and EXIF tools.

modules.name: Audio & Video Media Tools
modules.description: Enterprise media processing engines for audio converters, speech-to-text, video compressors, cutters, equalizers, and multimedia editors.

tools.name: Word to PDF Converter
tools.tagline: Convert DOCX and DOC documents into pristine PDF files.
tools.description: Easily convert Microsoft Word (.docx, .doc) files into universally compatible, high-quality PDF documents preserving layout, fonts, and images.

tools.name: Word to Excel Converter
tools.tagline: Extract tables and tabular data from Word into Excel spreadsheets.
tools.description: Intelligently scan Word documents for tables and structured lists, converting them into clean Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) or CSV spreadsheets.

tools.name: Word to PNG Converter
tools.tagline: Render pages of Word documents into crisp, high-resolution PNG images.
tools.description: Convert pages of DOCX/DOC documents into individual or multi-page PNG graphic images suitable for presentations and web sharing.

tools.name: Word to TXT Extractor
tools.tagline: Extract clean, unformatted plain text from Word documents.
tools.description: Strip formatting and extract raw plain text from Word files (.docx, .doc) with clean paragraph separation and encoding preservation.

tools.name: Excel to PNG Converter
tools.tagline: Export Excel sheets, charts, and tables as high-quality PNG images.
tools.description: Convert Microsoft Excel spreadsheets and tables into sharp PNG graphics with transparent or white background for reports and dashboards.

tools.name: Excel to PDF Converter
tools.tagline: Convert spreadsheets into cleanly formatted, printable PDF documents.
tools.description: Transform Excel workbooks (.xlsx, .xls) into professional PDF reports with fit-to-page scaling, page breaks, and customized margins.

tools.name: Excel to CSV Converter
tools.tagline: Convert multi-sheet Excel files into standard RFC-4180 CSV files.
tools.description: Extract tabular data from Excel spreadsheets and convert it into universal Comma-Separated Values (CSV) format with custom delimiters.

tools.name: CSV to Excel Converter
tools.tagline: Convert CSV files into Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbooks.
tools.description: Import CSV data files and generate formatted Excel (.xlsx) workbooks with auto-fitted column widths and auto-detected number formats.

tools.name: CSV to JSON Converter
tools.tagline: Convert CSV table rows into structured JSON arrays and objects.
tools.description: Transform comma-separated CSV records into clean, validated JSON datasets with automatic data type parsing (numbers, booleans, strings).

tools.name: CSV to XML Converter
tools.tagline: Convert tabular CSV records into hierarchical XML document trees.
tools.description: Parse CSV files and generate schema-compliant XML files with customizable root tags, record elements, and attribute mappings.

tools.name: CSV to Markdown Converter
tools.tagline: Convert CSV tables into GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) tables.
tools.description: Generate clean, beautifully formatted Markdown tables from CSV or TSV files, ready to paste directly into GitHub READMEs, docs, and notes.

tools.name: JSON to CSV Converter
tools.tagline: Convert JSON arrays and objects into downloadable CSV spreadsheet files.
tools.description: Flatten complex nested or flat JSON objects and arrays into standard CSV tabular format with customizable headers and delimiters.

tools.name: JSON to XML Converter
tools.tagline: Transform JSON payloads into well-formed XML documents.
tools.description: Seamlessly convert JSON strings, objects, and arrays into formatted XML documents with custom namespaces and root elements.

tools.name: JSON to BSON Converter
tools.tagline: Encode JSON objects into Binary JSON (BSON) format and hex representations.
tools.description: Convert JSON documents into MongoDB-compatible binary BSON files or inspectable hexadecimal stream representations.

tools.name: PowerPoint to PDF Converter
tools.tagline: Convert PPTX and PPT presentations into professional PDF handouts.
tools.description: Transform PowerPoint slide decks into high-resolution, vector-accurate PDF files with support for all slide dimensions and notes.

tools.name: PowerPoint to PNG Slides
tools.tagline: Export PowerPoint presentation slides as individual PNG images.
tools.description: Convert slide presentations (.pptx) into crisp PNG graphics ideal for web galleries, blog embeds, and social sharing.

tools.name: PowerPoint to JPG Slides
tools.tagline: Export PowerPoint slides into lightweight JPG graphics.
tools.description: Export all slides from a presentation deck into compressed, high-speed JPG files packaged for instant web download.

tools.name: EPUB to PDF Converter
tools.tagline: Convert EPUB electronic books into printable, formatted PDF documents.
tools.description: Format and convert EPUB e-books into clean PDF documents with table of contents, customizable typography, and page numbers.

tools.name: PDF to EPUB Converter
tools.tagline: Convert PDF documents into reflowable EPUB e-books.
tools.description: Transform PDF books and documents into reflowable EPUB files optimized for Apple Books, Kindle, and modern e-readers.

tools.name: RTF to PDF Converter
tools.tagline: Convert Rich Text Format (.rtf) documents to PDF format.
tools.description: Convert styled RTF documents into polished, standardized PDF files while preserving rich text formatting, styles, and alignments.

tools.name: PDF to RTF Converter
tools.tagline: Convert PDF documents into editable Rich Text Format files.
tools.description: Extract text, layout, and styling from PDF files and export into editable RTF documents compatible with WordPad and MS Word.

tools.name: HTML to PDF Converter
tools.tagline: Convert HTML web pages and source code into styled PDF documents.
tools.description: Render HTML documents or web snippets into PDF with full CSS styling, responsive media emulation, and background graphics.

tools.name: PDF to HTML Converter
tools.tagline: Extract PDF documents as interactive HTML5 web pages.
tools.description: Convert PDF documents into modern HTML5 pages with clean CSS, responsive text reflow, and embedded SVG vectors.

tools.name: PDF to Image Converter
tools.tagline: Convert PDF pages into high-resolution PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG graphics.
tools.description: Render and extract PDF pages into crisp raster or vector graphics. Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, and SVG formats with multi-page batch export.

tools.name: Merge PDF Files
tools.tagline: Combine multiple PDF files into a single organized document.
tools.description: Upload multiple PDF files, reorder pages intuitively with drag-and-drop, and merge them into a single, unified PDF document.

tools.name: Split PDF Pages
tools.tagline: Split large PDF files into separate documents or specific page ranges.
tools.description: Divide multi-page PDF documents into individual page files, extract custom ranges (e.g., 1-4, 7-10), or split by fixed intervals.

tools.name: Compress PDF
tools.tagline: Reduce PDF file size while preserving high visual sharpness.
tools.description: Optimize PDF streams, compress embedded images, and strip redundant metadata to dramatically decrease file size for email and web.

tools.name: Rotate PDF Pages
tools.tagline: Permanently rotate PDF pages clockwise, counter-clockwise, or 180°.
tools.description: Fix upside-down and sideways scanned PDF documents by rotating all or select pages by 90°, 180°, or 270° degrees.

tools.name: Crop PDF Pages
tools.tagline: Trim margins and custom crop PDF document page dimensions.
tools.description: Adjust CropBox and MediaBox bounds to trim unnecessary white borders or focus on specific content regions in your PDF files.

tools.name: PDF Extract Text & OCR
tools.tagline: Extract embedded text and run Optical Character Recognition (OCR).
tools.description: Extract text layers directly or run OCR on scanned PDF pages with multilingual language support and formatted text output.

tools.name: Extract Images from PDF
tools.tagline: Extract and download all embedded raster images from PDF files.
tools.description: Scan PDF documents for all embedded photographic images and graphics, extracting them at original native resolution into a ZIP archive.

tools.name: Protect PDF with Password
tools.tagline: Encrypt PDF documents with 256-bit AES password security.
tools.description: Add user and owner passwords to your PDF files. Restrict printing, copying, and modifications with enterprise encryption.

tools.name: Unlock PDF Password
tools.tagline: Remove password protection and printing restrictions from PDF files.
tools.description: Safely decrypt password-protected PDF files (when password is provided) to produce an unencumbered, standard PDF document.

tools.name: Digital Sign PDF
tools.tagline: Sign PDF documents with digital signature and cryptographic verification.
tools.description: Add visual handwritten signatures, corporate stamps, and verifiable cryptographic SHA-256 integrity metadata to your PDF documents.

tools.name: Add Watermark to PDF
tools.tagline: Stamp customized text or logo watermarks across PDF pages.
tools.description: Apply confidential stamps, copyright watermarks, and custom logos across all pages with customizable opacity, rotation, and position.

tools.name: Add Page Numbers to PDF
tools.tagline: Insert headers, footers, and pagination numbers on PDF pages.
tools.description: Customize and insert clean page numbering (e.g. 'Page 1 of 20') in top or bottom margins with selectable fonts, offsets, and styles.

tools.name: Redact PDF Content
tools.tagline: Permanently sanitize and black out sensitive data from PDF files.
tools.description: Permanently blackout names, social security numbers, credit cards, or keyword patterns to guarantee privacy compliance.

tools.name: Universal Image Converter
tools.tagline: Convert between PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, BMP, HEIC, AVIF, TIFF, PSD, AI, EPS, DDS, EXR, and RAW formats.
tools.description: High-performance multi-format image converter supporting standard web formats (PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, BMP, AVIF, HEIC) as well as professional formats (TIFF, PSD, AI, EPS, DDS, EXR, DNG, CR2, NEF).

tools.name: Image Resizer
tools.tagline: Resize images by exact pixel dimensions, percentages, or social presets.
tools.description: Scale and resize photos and graphics with bicubic interpolation, aspect ratio lock, and preset templates for YouTube, Instagram, and web.

tools.name: Smart Image Compressor
tools.tagline: Compress image file sizes up to 90% without visible loss in quality.
tools.description: Optimize PNG, JPG, and WebP images with perceptual compression algorithms to drastically improve page speed and bandwidth savings.

tools.name: Image Cropper
tools.tagline: Crop, frame, and cut images with freeform or fixed aspect ratios.
tools.description: Interactive visual canvas image cropper with grid overlays, aspect ratio locks (1:1, 16:9, 4:3, 3:2), and circle avatar cropping.

tools.name: AI Background Remover
tools.tagline: Remove image backgrounds automatically with transparent cutout generation.
tools.description: Isolate people, products, and foreground objects from complex backgrounds using smart edge-detection and AI alpha channel segmentation.

tools.name: Image Color Picker & Palette
tools.tagline: Extract dominant color palettes, HEX codes, RGB, and contrast analysis.
tools.description: Upload any graphic to extract top harmonious color palettes, calculate WCAG accessibility contrast ratios, and copy CSS color variables.

tools.name: Artistic Image Filters
tools.tagline: Apply Vintage, Vignette, Glitch, Sepia, Grayscale, and Blur filters.
tools.description: Transform photos instantly with live canvas filters including Vintage film, Vignette lens shading, Cyberpunk RGB Glitch, Sepia, and Sharpen.

tools.name: EXIF Metadata Viewer
tools.tagline: Inspect camera model, exposure settings, GPS coordinates, and date tags.
tools.description: Read comprehensive EXIF, IPTC, and XMP metadata from camera photos including aperture, ISO, shutter speed, lens focal length, and geolocation.

tools.name: EXIF Metadata Eraser
tools.tagline: Strip GPS location, camera serials, and private EXIF tags before sharing.
tools.description: Protect your privacy by stripping all embedded EXIF tags, GPS geolocations, device identifiers, and timestamp data from photos.

tools.name: Image Watermark Adder
tools.tagline: Overlay customizable text or logo watermarks over images.
tools.description: Protect intellectual property with custom text watermarks or PNG logo stamps with position grids, opacity sliders, and angle rotations.

tools.name: AI Image Upscaler
tools.tagline: Upscale low-resolution photos 2x or 4x with enhanced edge sharpness.
tools.description: Super-resolution image upscaler using deep edge-enhancement and bicubic filtering to increase image dimensions without pixelation.

tools.name: Universal Audio Converter
tools.tagline: Convert between MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG, M4A, WMA, AMR, AIFF, Opus, AC3, ALAC, PCM, M4B, and MP2 formats.
tools.description: High-fidelity audio format converter with custom bitrate (128kbps - 320kbps), sample rate, and audio channel controls.

tools.name: Audio to Text Transcription
tools.tagline: Transcribe speech and dialogues from audio files into accurate text.
tools.description: AI-powered speech recognition engine leveraging OpenAI Whisper architecture with multilingual support and automatic timestamps.

tools.name: Voice to Text Converter
tools.tagline: Convert voice memos and recordings into formatted text transcripts.
tools.description: Fast voice dictation and voice memo transcription with background noise filtering and punctuation reconstruction.

tools.name: Smart Audio Compressor
tools.tagline: Reduce audio file sizes up to 80% while retaining high listening clarity.
tools.description: Optimize audio files with advanced VBR (Variable Bitrate) and psychoacoustic frequency preservation for podcast and web distribution.

tools.name: Audio Cutter & Trimmer
tools.tagline: Trim, cut, and split audio tracks with waveform visual boundaries.
tools.description: Cut precise segments from songs, ringtones, and podcast recordings with fade-in and fade-out envelope controls.

tools.name: Audio Joiner & Merger
tools.tagline: Merge multiple songs and audio tracks into a single unified file.
tools.description: Combine multiple audio tracks with smooth crossfades, gapless playback, and normalized volume levels across all tracks.

tools.name: Audio Volume Booster
tools.tagline: Amplify and boost audio volume up to 500% with clipping prevention.
tools.description: Boost quiet recordings, lectures, and audiobooks with dynamic peak limiting to prevent distortion and speaker blowouts.

tools.name: Audio Speed & Pitch Changer
tools.tagline: Change audio playback speed (0.5x to 2.0x) with independent pitch control.
tools.description: Speed up podcasts or slow down music lessons while keeping the natural pitch intact, or create custom chipmunk/nightcore effects.

tools.name: Online Voice Recorder
tools.tagline: Record crystal-clear voice memos directly from your browser microphone.
tools.description: Record high-quality audio through your microphone with real-time waveform feedback and instant MP3/WAV download.

tools.name: AI Audio Noise Reduction
tools.tagline: Remove background hiss, room hum, and air conditioner noise.
tools.description: AI spectral subtraction engine removes stationary background noise while keeping voices crisp and natural.

tools.name: 10-Band Audio Equalizer
tools.tagline: Sculpt audio frequency spectrum with professional 10-band graphic EQ.
tools.description: Fine-tune frequencies from 31Hz to 16kHz with studio presets including Bass Boost, Vocal Clarifier, Acoustic, and Electronic.

tools.name: AI Vocal Remover & Karaoke Maker
tools.tagline: Separate vocals and backing instrumentals from any song.
tools.description: Extract acapella vocal stems and create studio-quality karaoke instrumental backing tracks using phase isolation.

tools.name: BPM & Musical Key Analyzer
tools.tagline: Detect tempo (BPM), musical key, and rhythm structure of songs.
tools.description: Analyze tempo metrics, Camelot key signatures, and harmonic spectrum profile for DJ mixing and music production.

tools.name: Universal Video Converter
tools.tagline: Convert between MP4, AVI, MOV, MKV, WEBM, FLV, 3GP, M4V, VOB, MPG, WMV, SWF, TS, M2TS, OGV, MXF, F4V, and RMVB.
tools.description: High-performance video transcoder supporting all modern and legacy video formats with resolution scaling and H.264/HEVC encoding.

tools.name: Video to Audio Extractor
tools.tagline: Extract high-quality MP3, WAV, AAC, or FLAC audio from video files.
tools.description: Rip audio soundtracks, music clips, and speech from video files (.mp4, .mov, .mkv, .avi) with maximum audio fidelity.

tools.name: Smart Video Compressor
tools.tagline: Compress video files for Discord, WhatsApp, email, and web without noticeable quality loss.
tools.description: Reduce large video file sizes using intelligent two-pass CRF compression optimized for instant sharing.

tools.name: Video Cutter & Trimmer
tools.tagline: Trim and cut video clips with live player scrubber and precise timestamps.
tools.description: Cut unwanted beginnings and endings from video clips with stream-copy instant rendering or re-encoded precision.

tools.name: Video Mute & Audio Stripper
tools.tagline: Remove audio and sound tracks completely from video files.
tools.description: Strip background sound and audio streams from videos to create 100% silent MP4 or WebM files.

tools.name: Video Speed Modifier
tools.tagline: Create slow-motion (0.25x) or fast-motion (up to 4x) video effects.
tools.description: Speed up or slow down video footage with frame interpolation and audio pitch sync.

tools.name: Video Watermark Adder
tools.tagline: Overlay customizable text or logo watermarks on video footage.
tools.description: Protect intellectual property with transparent PNG watermark logos or copyright text placed anywhere on the video frame.

tools.name: Subtitle Format Converter
tools.tagline: Convert between SRT, VTT (WebVTT), ASS, SSA, and TTML subtitle formats.
tools.description: Seamlessly convert SubRip (.srt) into HTML5 WebVTT (.vtt) and vice versa with accurate millisecond timestamp transformation.

tools.name: Video Frame Extractor
tools.tagline: Extract high-resolution image snapshots and frames from video files.
tools.description: Capture exact frame snapshots from videos in PNG or JPG format at specific timestamps or extract consecutive sequences.

tools.name: Video Metadata Editor
tools.tagline: Edit title, artist, album, genre, and year metadata tags in video files.
tools.description: Inspect and update MP4 atoms, Matroska tags, and metadata headers without re-encoding video streams.

tools.name: Video to GIF Converter
tools.tagline: Convert short video clips into high-quality animated GIFs.
tools.description: Create animated GIFs from videos with custom frame rates (FPS), loop controls, and optimized color palette dithering.
